newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni sale share price should be 6,910 lire.
newsitem.headline: Eni sale share price should be 6,910 lire.

text.p: The final share price of the public sale offer of a second tranche in Italian energy group Eni SpA should be 6,910 lire, bourse traders said.
This price is reached by subtracting the 3.5 percent price discount for retail investors from Friday's official Milan stock exchange average price for the day of 7,161 lire.

The price fixing procedure has been arranged to apply the lower price between the maximum price fixed by the Treasury at 7,425 lire and the official price today, the last day of the week-long public sale offer, discounted by 3.5 percent.
Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi is due to hold news conference at 1700 GMT Saturday to discuss pricing details.
The Treasury said on Thursday it was increasing the total number of Eni shares offered for sale to 1.1 billion from 700 million.
